## SnapSort 1.1.1 — Cleaner, calmer

**New: a flatter, more polished look.** Every gradient is gone: the Favorites card, buttons and empty screens now use solid colours, and the app icon has a clean violet background.

- The Latest cards show the app and time in frosted pills instead of a dark fade.
- The sample screenshots in onboarding are simpler and emoji-free.

Updating? Just install over the old version — your albums and favorites stay.
